_provenance.notes: Southeast Alaska troll (hook-and-line) fishery is the highest-quality, highest-value salmon fishery per fish in Alaska. Fresh-bled, ice-slurry chilled Chinook and Coho are marketed premium-grade. 2024 SEAK troll Chinook averaged $10.80/lb ex-vessel — highest on record. The fishery is constrained by Pacific Salmon Treaty (PSC Chapter 3) Chinook interception caps negotiated with Canada. Troll seasons are typically spring (May-June) and summer (July-August). Permits: T09B (Chinook/Coho), T09A (Pink/Chum).
